caption: Hand-written __init__, and an unhelpful default print.
One decorator writes __init__, __repr__, and __eq__ for you.

code:
cfg2 = APIConfig(api_key="sk-123")
print(cfg == cfg2)
# True — same field values,
# even though they're two
# separate objects
caption: A plain class's == checks identity; a dataclass's checks field values.

code:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Point:
    x: int
    y: int

p = Point(1, 2)
p.x = 5
# FrozenInstanceError:
# cannot assign to field 'x'
caption: frozen=True blocks reassignment after construction.

subtitle: Connecting classes, inheritance, and dataclasses to real SDK design.
